create.name: Sara Teal
create.bio:
Sara Teal is a sound practitioner and yoga teacher in Sheffield. She came to this work from the arts: she trained as a visual artist, with a fine art MA from Sheffield Hallam, and taught art and photography before turning to yoga, breath and sound. She now holds 500-hour senior yoga teacher status and has trained in yin yoga with Bernie Clark, in sound therapy with Jane Ford-Ferrand, and in breathwork, and she is a Reiki Master Teacher who also works with Sekhem energy healing.

Her sound sessions use Himalayan and quartz crystal bowls, a sacred frame drum, gongs and her own voice. Most months she holds evening sound baths and gong baths at a church hall in Hillsborough, timed with new moons, solstices and the turn of the year, where people lie down and simply listen. She brings together an interest in how the body and nervous system respond to sound with a respect for the subtle and sacred side of the practice, and keeps the tone unhurried and without expectation. She also trains others through a five-day Sound Therapy Facilitator Diploma in Sheffield, leads women's retreats in the Pennines, works with community groups and schools, and shares chakra-themed bowl, drum and mantra recordings on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Sound Baths in Sheffield
courses.description: Regular evening sound baths at Trinity Methodist Church in Hillsborough. After a short settling-in, she plays Himalayan and crystal bowls, sacred drum and voice while people lie and listen, with no state to reach and room for rest or quiet reflection.

courses.title: Sound Therapy Facilitator Diploma
courses.description: A five-day in-person training at Sheffield Yoga Centre for people who want to lead sound sessions professionally or add sound to an existing practice. It covers gongs, bowls, drum and voice, one-to-one and group facilitation, pacing and silence, ethics and safeguarding, followed by online learning, mentoring and case studies.

courses.title: Spring Equinox Women's Retreat: Reconnect, Release & Rise
courses.description: A weekend retreat for women at Westwood, a restored chapel in the Pennines near Huddersfield, timed with the spring equinox. Using old photographs, sharing and being listened to, yoga, cacao, breathwork and sound, it looks back at earlier selves and forward to what comes next.

free_resources.title: Sound Bath With Bowls For Heart And Throat Chakras
free_resources.description: A 35-minute recorded sound bath with singing bowls tuned to the heart and throat centres. Free to play on Insight Timer.

free_resources.title: Sacred Drum Meditation Focusing On Root & Heart Chakras
free_resources.description: An eight-minute drum journey that opens with a slow, steady beat for grounding before moving to the heart. Free on Insight Timer.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 794 followers (profile, 3 Nov 2026); no YouTube channel or other personal social accounts linked from her site (the only Instagram link, on the retreat page, belongs to a co-facilitator) → ~0.8k readable → local_hero
flags: Found in a second Insight Timer pass: she appears in Insight Timer's Nottingham-area local list, but her own site says 'Based in Sheffield' and all her events are in Sheffield (Hillsborough).

Gong bath page says gong vibration 'can assist in understanding and processing trauma' and speaks of 'healing frequencies'; the gong bath offering is left out under the health rule, and a human may want to check the sound bath page too (it is clean).
Winter Solstice event page says the pine-needle tea served will 'strengthen immunity'; that event is left out.

The diploma page describes the training as 'trauma-informed' and 'rooted in nervous-system regulation'; kept, as that describes the facilitator's approach rather than a treatment claim, but a human may want to check.
Her about page lists a 'Certified Trauma-Informed Coach' credential and work in mental health services; her public offerings are sound, yoga and retreats, which is what the page covers.
The spring retreat is co-led; the co-facilitator's Instagram (dance.to.your.natural.rhythm) is not hers and is not linked.
Both photos are from her own site (a headshot and a photo at Giza) and show the same woman.
left_out: Gong baths (9 Dec new moon, 30 Dec New Year): the gong page claims help with processing trauma.
Winter Solstice Sound Bath (18 Dec 2026): the page claims the tea served strengthens immunity.
Sound bath on 4 Nov 2026: started before 6 Nov (the repeating sound bath page is used instead).
Insight Timer tracks titled 'Crystal Healing Bowl ... To Balance Root Chakra' and dated live recordings (kept to two).
Corporate and private group bookings (hire-me page).
Sound bath price: shown only inside the booking system.
